title: Dhikr & Dua - Quran & Sunnah,
meta_description: Authentic Duas from Quran & Sunnah with audio recitation and Dua of the day.
full_description: Dhikr & Dua is a collection of 262 authentic Duas from holy Quran and Sunnah. The app has a simple, and elegant design with audio recitation, favorites, categories, Dua of the day, search and share Duas. Beautiful high quality Dua audio recitations for all Duas with proper Tajweed and Qiraath Learn a new dua everyday with daily Dua of the day notificationsSearch and discover new Duas, favorite them and share with your families and friendsAll duas have transliteration and are available in English and Bahasa Melayu languages. 1.      Holy Quran2.      Hisnul Muslim book written by Sa'id bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani3.      Duas from Quran book written by Al-Haji Nijamudeen Manbayee
